mapper.select: SELECT aa.id, aa.attempt_id AS attemptId, aa.question_id AS questionId, aa.selected_keys AS selectedKeys, aa.answer_text AS answerText, aa.is_flagged AS isFlagged, aa.score_gained AS scoreGained, aa.answered_at AS answeredAt, q.question_no AS questionNo, q.type, q.score, q.title, q.correct_answer AS correctAnswer, q.reference_answer AS referenceAnswer, q.analysis FROM attempt_answer aa JOIN exam_question q ON q.id = aa.question_id WHERE aa.attempt_id = #{attemptId} ORDER BY q.question_no, q.id
